inlines.v: MAN'AGEABLE, adjective Easy to be used or directed to its proper purpose; not difficult to be moved or wielded. Heavy cannon are not very manageable 1. Governable; tractable; that may be controlled; as a manageable horse. 2. That may be made subservient to one's views or designs.
